integrity: The analytic proof establishes the theorem; finite rational computations corroborate special cases. The displayed limiting law and formulas have not undergone independent audit.
scientific_limitations: For normalized planar Lebesgue initial law; all real positive moment orders and all nonnegative integer times; exact Wasserstein identity only from time two; a specified null-boundary extension makes the limit non-invariant. No claim about general piecewise isometries or arbitrary initial measures. Novelty remains subject to potential unindexed prior exact analyses.
title: Exact moment spectrum and Gaussian focusing in a countable piecewise isometry
